issues.description: Format B crashes with AttributeError when metrics is present but not a JSON object.
Malformed Format C XML raises ParseError and aborts the whole ingest instead of producing a structured warning.
Ingest only upserts current records and never removes stale results from prior runs when input files disappear or a smaller dataset is loaded.
Empty-directory ingest returns an error after creating or modifying the SQLite database.
Format A persists rows with empty required identifiers such as model, task, or run_id instead of warning and skipping malformed rows.
Format B silently coerces missing model_name or benchmark to empty strings and persists incomplete canonical records.
Format C accepts empty run id, model, or task fields and writes invalid logical records.
Duplicate correction counting applies to every source even though the documented correction semantics are Format B-specific.
Format A parses CSV line-by-line, so valid CSV records with embedded newlines in quoted fields will be split and mishandled.
Parsers load whole input files into memory or parse the whole XML document at once, which limits scalability on large result sets.
Project metadata does not declare test/dev dependencies such as pytest, making setup less reproducible.
